text:
lia (design): tossing up a tiny experiment idea: replace the big schema banner with a per-fn "validation pill" on the defs list. it's a small badge (e.g., !1) that expands an inline inspector below the row with short messages and links.
omar (devex): inline pill sounds lighter. question: badge on the row only or also in editor header? row-only to reduce editor noise.
lia (design): row-only. inspector shows breadcrumbs to the failing field and a short snippet of the offending input.
kai (backend): backend ok. implementation note: re-run the linter when opening but debounce 250ms and cache result for 30s. keep cached summary <= 256 chars.
ada (a11y): accessibility: inspector must be role="region" aria-label="function validation" and announce changes via aria-live="polite". keyboard: Enter to toggle, Shift+Enter focus first error, Esc to close and return focus to pill.
sara (product): while you're at it, propose a "run snippet" card in run history: tool name, one-line summary (first sentence), small cost chip (tokens/$) and a chevron. expand shows full structured output and supports streaming.
omar (devex): run snippet should show a pulsing live dot when streaming. store only summary+pointer on the run list and lazy-load full payload on expand. add focus trap when expanded and a clear Close control.
kai (backend): data contract I'll draft: summaryText, pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. pointer can be internal id or s3 path.
ada (a11y): copy nits: prefer "Call arguments" over "Args" and ensure cost chip has an aria-label like "Estimated cost: 14 tokens, $0.02". on expand announce "Tool output expanded".
preview-bot: lia uploaded preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-pill-run-snippet
lia (design): action items: omar write keyboard/focus RFC, kai draft pointer contract + debounce, ada produce a11y checklist, sara set beta metrics. thanks!
